polish.notes: favicon.svg, apple-touch, og.jpg present. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: R-50 vs R-51 mismatch for one reading (-0.5). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: feature card void (-0.5 shared with layout, not doubled: here the inconsistent card heights).

elevate.move: Give the page a second and third plate from the library inside the ruler system: an attic/interior frame clipped by the story ruler as the fill rises (photo revealed by the loose-fill line), and a winter exterior plate on the contact band, so the photos read as a plan-to-result sequence filed as P-01/P-02/P-03 on the report.

Make the ruler the one moving part everywhere: the F-05 attic ruler tool fills on entry to its default reading, the section-rail rulers fill with scroll progress of their own section, and the footer flat ruler draws its ticks 0-20 as the sign-off, so the signature moves in four places, not two.
